description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'GeneratorTest' which includes unit tests for the 'Generator' class in the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Confluence' namespace. The tests mock interactions with the Confluence API to verify page creation, updating, deletion, attachment handling, and overall publishing logic within the Daux documentation generator framework.

classes.name: GeneratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite that verifies the behavior of the 'Generator' class responsible for publishing documentation pages and managing content in Confluence, including creation, updates, deletions, and attachments.

methods.name: configurationTestProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for configuration validation tests.

methods.name: testConfiguration
methods.description: Tests the configuration validation logic, ensuring mandatory options are enforced.

methods.name: initPublish
methods.description: Initializes a testing environment by setting up a virtual filesystem and returning a configured 'GlobalConfig' object.

methods.name: runPublish
methods.description: Simulates the publishing process with mocked API interactions, handling page creation, updates, and other operations.

methods.name: testPublishAllPages
methods.description: Verifies the process of publishing all pages while creating new pages and setting content.

methods.name: testUpdatePublishedPages
methods.description: Checks that existing pages are correctly updated and unchanged pages are not modified, including version handling.

methods.name: testDeletePages
methods.description: Ensures obsolete pages are deleted when the 'delete' flag is set.

methods.name: testWarnAboutDelete
methods.description: Verifies the behavior when deletion is disabled, ensuring pages are only listed and not deleted.

methods.name: testFindRootByAncestor
methods.description: Tests locating or creating a root page by ancestor ID and publishing child pages.

methods.name: testCreateRootAndPublishAllPages
methods.description: Checks creating a new root page in Confluence if it does not exist and publishing all child pages.

methods.name: testCreateRootWithSiblingSpaceAndPublishAllPages
methods.description: Validates creating a root page in a sibling space when the ancestor exists but the target page does not.

methods.name: testRootNotFound
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the specified root page cannot be found and no creation flag is set, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testRootNotFoundButFoundSiblings
methods.description: Ensures proper error handling when the root page is not found but sibling pages exist with different names.

methods.name: testPublishAttachments
methods.description: Verifies attachments (images) are uploaded correctly and linked within content.

methods.name: testMixed
methods.description: Performs an integrated test, covering creation, update, deletion, and dry-run modes with detailed output verification.
